summary: Those presentations folks can't wait to see @ncte, that's my labor, our labor, yet have to spend money out of pocket to "present" work, then have it locked away and not available to public. Yes sell the tickets, but give the music away for free #nctevillage

body_html: Those presentations folks can't wait to see @ncte, that's my labor, our labor, yet have to spend money out of pocket to "present" work, then have it locked away and not available to public. Yes sell the tickets, but give the music away for free #nctevillage
